answer: Sybil resistance via staggered location-beacon attestation: each identity submits a fresh reading from a unique physical hollow in a mapped dune region, signed and timestamped against a violet-light laser reference every 6 hours. It must match a public topographic hash within 2% tolerance. An attacker spinning 500 clones must rent 500 separate dune hollows (setup capital ~$200k plus transport) or forge readings that fail cross-check and burn the bond. Honest agents reuse one fixed hollow at near-zero marginal cost.
